notes.text: New: Signatures can be formatted as HTML for individual identities
Fixed: Reply prompts users to choose Reply or Reply All when both are applicable
Fixed: Selected compose text was invisible in light theme due to white highlighting
Fixed: Status bar icons became unreadable when selecting messages in light theme
Fixed: Recipient expander would not collapse after editing message subject or body
Fixed: Thunderbird could crash when adding an attachment to a message using the camera
Fixed: Save All incorrectly saved each attachment using the content of the last file
Fixed: Editing queued mail as new used the default identity instead of the original one
Fixed: QR code scanner failed to open when no accounts were configured
Fixed: Unsupported QR codes did not display feedback after scanning
Fixed: With a hardware keyboard the focus could not leave To, Cc or Bcc
Changed: Long account names are resized to fit within two lines in the account drawer
